profile.description: Mistral-Small-4 is a significant iteration within the Mistral-Small series. It consolidates the functionalities of several Mistral models into a singular, cohesive system. This advanced model seamlessly integrates the robust reasoning prowess of Magistral, the comprehensive multimodal understanding inherent in Pixtral, and the sophisticated agentic coding capabilities derived from Devstral.
